caption: The drawing depicts the interior of a room with three distinct sections on the visible wall. The ceiling is bordered with wide, red trim, and wooden beams are illustrated overhead in gray and brown tones. The upper section of the wall is decorated with a horizontal strip of red floral or geometric designs. There are three large, pointed arches outlined in blue with red vertical accents along the sides, forming niches or recesses in the wall; the central arch encompasses a brown wooden double door with visible grain and panels. Above the central arch, there is a red, star-like decorative element. The arch on the right contains a shelving unit or window with three shelves, where objects or red designs are visible. The lower section of the wall, beneath the arches, is adorned with a horizontal band of repeating blue and red floral motifs. The walls and floor are primarily shaded in pale beige or gray, with the floor showing a brown and orange checkered or tile pattern. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner by "Geoffrey Holt and Harry Mata Waddell."
title: Restoration Drawing: Wall Painting
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
